status: FROZEN before any two-player run (after the single CALIB run, which had no recipient within 10 m)
t0Note: K clip time of the tackler's start: the airborne scissor (lowest V2 point ≈ 0.17 m above the turf; K COM 6.7 m/s forward, 1.05 m high). K's authored run-up accelerates 2.5 → 7 m/s in 0.25 s (≈ 1.8 g from one stance leg), which no physical body can reproduce; the physical tackler therefore starts in the air at K's own dive state and receives NO root propulsion
activateNote: step at which the parked tackler becomes dynamic (1.7 s): the recipient has stood under C3 for 1.7 s, as in the BALANCE battery's 2 s settle
speedsNote: the single varied external parameter: horizontal approach speed as a factor of K's own COM speed at t0 (6.7 m/s): 3.3 / 6.7 / 8.4 m/s; every body gets the same (s − 1) × horizontal COM velocity added (limb motion unchanged)

calib.note: CALIB: the tackler alone 10 m clear of the recipient (no contact), to measure the physical boot path from the start

placementRule: From CALIB (NOMINAL speed, tackler alone): 0.22 s after activation the right boot (COM) is at 0.20 m height, just after landing, moving −z at ≈ 5 m/s. Target: the boot passes through the recipient's LEFT shank axis (x −0.03, z +0.21 local, the lower shin) at t_c = 0.22 s. Lateral offset x = 0.29 m (the boot runs 0.32 m to the −x side of the K pose offset). Along the line of travel: boot displacement over t_c = s·ΔzCOM + (Δz_boot − ΔzCOM) with ΔzCOM = −1.43 m and Δz_boot − ΔzCOM = −0.07 m measured in CALIB; the horizontal COM motion is ballistic until landing (≈ 0.19 s), so the start moves back by 1.43 m per unit speed factor: offset z = 2.42 + 1.43·s. The same rule for every strength; nothing tuned per case.
calibObservations: CALIB (no recipient): flight 0.19 s, landing on the left upper arm / thigh / foot at ≈ 4.7 m/s vertical; slide decelerates ≈ 5–6 m/s², stops 2.9 m from the start by +1.0 s; the right (tackling) boot comes down and drags on the turf from +0.25 s (authored: raised ≈ 0.16 m); tracking error 15–22° RMS after landing; 4,135 M1b strain-arm yield events (tackler)
